C1369.title: Multichain Cross-Chain Bridge Abnormal Fund Transfer Incident
C1369.summary: In July 2023, cross-chain bridge Multichain experienced abnormal fund outflows involving up to 210 million US dollars. According to the official Twitter account, the outflowing funds were transferred by family members of CEO Zhao Jun, who had been taken by Chinese police. The event moved large amounts of locked assets and reflected centralization risks in core control, operational transparency, and asset custody arrangements for cross-chain bridge projects.
